user.title: Thames Water
user.description: Sign in with the details you use on the Thames Water website. Your accounts and meters are found automatically.

data_description.username: The email address you sign in to Thames Water with.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your password
reauth_confirm.description: Thames Water rejected the stored password for {username}.

error.invalid_auth: Thames Water did not accept that email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Thames Water. Try again shortly.

abort.already_configured: This Thames Water account is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Thames Water accepted the new password.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Fetches older readings and writes them into the consumption and cost statistics. Re-running it is safe: a reading already written is overwritten with the same value.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: The first day to import. Readings exist from before you moved in, so a start earlier than your move-in date imports the previous occupant's usage.
